debt.text: He pledges never to vote to cut Social Security, Medicare, or Medicaid.
debt.quote: I will never vote to cut Social Security, Medicare, or Medicaid

safety.text: He calls for increased funding for local law enforcement to keep communities safe.
safety.quote: increase funding for local law enforcement to help keep our communities safe

immigration.text: He calls for making illegal entry harder while making legal immigration easier, pairing more border enforcement with an easier legal process.
immigration.quote: We need to make it harder to enter our country illegally, but easier to enter legally.

tax.text: Constantino says he backs tax credits for working families and wants to grow the economy to put more money in people's pockets.
tax.quote: I support tax credits for working families to help them raise their families.

schools.text: Constantino says he supports school choice.
schools.quote: I also support school choice, which is very important.

immigration.text: Constantino's agenda calls for permanently securing the northern border to stop illegal crossings, working with President Trump.
immigration.quote: Work with President Trump to stop drugs, crime, terrorism, and low-wage labor from crossing our northern border.

guns.text: Constantino says he will fight to protect and restore Second Amendment rights he says Democrats took away in New York.
guns.quote: Democrats took away our 2nd Amendment Rights in New York and perpetually attack our First Amendment rights nationally.

energy.text: Constantino pledges to cut green energy regulations and end solar farm deals to bring down utility and other prices.
energy.quote: Cut and oppose senseless regulations that drive up prices including insane food, restaurant, and green energy regulations that have made costs skyrocket.
